subject: [hw] opus-decint: vc19 decode analysed: VDEC DECODED (LAT+CORE done irqs); failure = VDEC_CORE power-off bus-protection ack; daemon fix restaged (82b97233) + kernel q10jf built (7acf035f)
body: vc19b: per frame dec: ev wait_isr LAT 0 / CORE 0 (done in 8-12 ms), first picture in list_disp. Then VDEC_CORE power-off: kernel 'bus protection 0x40 not acknowledged (0x103)' -> -60, which n2ap_vdec made a decode error (dprobe detail=57 = elapsed ms of the ETIMEDOUT request). Root cause: n2vc_hw_off gated VDEC_CKEN/LAT_CKEN/LARB1_CKEN before MM_2 bit6 protection; Linux never clears them (clk-mt6885-vde.c GATE_INV_DUMMY = mtk_clk_gate_ops_setclr_inv_dummy, disable is a no-op), so spm_mtcmos_ctrl_vde2 handshakes with clocks running. FIXES: (1) rootfs: n2ap_vdec treats a failed power-off as non-fatal; adapter holds one VDEC_SOC+CORE ref per session (no per-frame power cycle; on q10je one harmless failed off at CLOSE). PC replay N2VC_FAKE_VDEC_CORE_OFF_FAIL=1 ENC=1 run_sim PASS 2x10. Payloads payload-vcodec-dec + payload-vcodec-hevc restaged (vcodecd 82b97233d254d686, dprobe 3c2998ff), REHEARSAL_OK. (2) kernel q10jf = q10je recipe + 0310 4cbc3bde (no CKEN gating before VDE/VDE2 protection; kern.n2vctrace default 0, relay fix kept): gpu/build/device-mmu-q10jf-candidate/ui-sched/nord2-ios-metal-q10jf-ui654fb60dvfs-cap3500-ram3776-sched.img sha256 7acf035f66021372..., spare 4096, kernel 8f1429ce; K02 588919 x4, IK 5909. venc_fast NOT included (opus-enc4k patch not landed). Either works with the new payload; q10jf removes the failure itself. Not device tested; needs user approval to flash.
